Despite President Trump's public criticism of Israel's conduct of its war in Lebanon, Israel's Ambassador to the UN @dannydanon insists there's no rift. "We fought together, we won the war together," he tells me. "This MOU, it's only the start of the negotiations, and I take him [at] his word that Iran will not obtain nuclear capabilities."

Our full interview airs at 6pm ET @cnni and tonight on @PBS

Ahead of talks with Iran, "the president's given up some of his leverage," says @SangerNYT. On vowing not to have a nuclear weapon, "they first made that statement in 1970," he notes, while Iran is likely to benefit from oil sales "almost right away... That leaves the president in a very risky spot."
